rows.title: CVE-2026-45186
rows.reason: Located span is the O(n) linear default-attribute collision loop in defineAttribute that PR #1216 replaces with a hash lookup (ELEMENT_TYPE.defaultAttsNames); the advisory describes exactly this quadratic collision check as the DoS.

rows.title: CVE-2026-50219
rows.reason: Located lines are the notStandaloneHandler call that the depth-tracking PR rewrites so the handler invocation can be wrapped in beforeHandler/afterHandler; the advisory names these handler calls as the reentry/UAF vector.

rows.title: CVE-2026-56131
rows.reason: Located line is the XML_ResumeParser null guard that the fix extends with isCalledFromInsideHandler(parser); the advisory is the reentry of XML_ResumeParser from inside a handler.

rows.title: CVE-2026-56404
rows.reason: Located line is the m_namespaceSeparator branch in addBinding where the fix adds the INT_MAX guard before len++ (the same guard is added in the URI-length loop); the advisory is the signed integer overflow in addBinding.

rows.title: CVE-2026-76957
rows.reason: Located line is the unknownEncodingRelease call in XML_ParserReset that the fix routes through callUnknownEncodingRelease, which applies handler call depth tracking; the advisory is custom encoding callbacks reentering the parser.

rows.title: Expat before 2.8.5 Malformed UTF-16 Acceptance via Unchecked Surrogate
rows.reason: The located hunk comes from commit 4b3f0b06, a release/mailmap merge whose series matched a copyright line in xmltok_impl.c; the real fix is ff6e1d7e (PR #1282). Its anchor (the IS_INVALID_CHAR fallback at xmltok_impl.c:44-46 and the UTF-16 engine tables) has no enclosing function, so it cannot be expressed as a function-scoped source location under the current schema.
